organization.short_description:
Chime is a prominent American financial technology company and the largest digital bank in the United States, founded in 2012 by Chris Britt and Ryan King. Headquartered in San Francisco, California, with additional offices in Chicago and New York, Chime launched its services in 2014. The company partners with FDIC-insured banks to provide a range of banking services, focusing on transparency and low costs.

Chime offers a variety of digital banking products through its mobile app, including a fee-free checking account, a high-yield savings account, and a secured credit card designed to help users build credit. The platform also features tools for early wage access, peer-to-peer payments, bill management, and financial education resources. With approximately 7 million active users and a valuation of around $25 billion, Chime aims to serve everyday Americans seeking a more accessible and consumer-friendly banking experience.
